subject: SLA flexibility request for ArkByte pilot - exec endorsement requested
messages:
From: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@arkbyte.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@arkbyte.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA flexibility request for ArkByte pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — ArkByte's engineering and infra teams were impressed with Redwood's throughput and the cost guidance. We're preparing the pilot contract for our internal procurement committee and ran into a couple of compliance/ops asks that are blocking signature:

- For the initial 6-month pilot, we need the SLO for availability relaxed from your standard 99.9% to 99.5%. This is a temporary pilot constraint due to our workload burst patterns.
- We would like a cap on annual service credits to a 10% maximum (our procurement cannot accept uncapped credit liabilities for pilot spend).
- A one-time onboarding discount or credit would help offset migration effort.

I've attached our security and compliance profile and a short note from procurement. Can you confirm whether Redwood can ship a pilot with those non-standard remedies and a capped credit? If not, what alternative remedies would you propose so we can move forward?

Proposed kickoff: week of Apr 12.

Thanks,
Dana Brooks
Head of Platform & Integrations
ArkByte
attachments: ArkByte-Security-Profile.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@arkbyte.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA flexibility request for ArkByte pilot

Dana — appreciate the clear asks and the packet. Short version: we can likely accommodate a pilot with a temporary availability adjustment and a capped credits structure, but we need executive sign-off for the non-standard remedy and the commercial concession.

Suggested terms (proposal attached):
- Pilot duration: 6 months.
- Availability SLO: 99.5% (pilot-only, auto-reverts to standard 99.9% at renewal).
- Service credit cap: 10% of monthly invoice for the period (10% annualized cap included in doc).
- Remedy: For incidents where availability SLO is missed, credits calculated per the standard schedule but limited by the cap; Redwood will provide a postmortem and a prioritized remediation plan.
- Commercial: one-time 15% onboarding credit against the first two invoices.

Ask: Sean / Lauren / Ben — can you review and confirm whether leadership will approve the SLO downgrade + credit cap + 15% credit? If ok, I'll produce an addendum and route to ArkByte's procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
attachments: RDW-proposed-term-sheet-arkbyte-v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA flexibility request for ArkByte pilot

Marissa — reviewed. I'm comfortable endorsing the pilot SLO at 99.5% and the 10% service credit cap for a 6-month trial on the following conditions:

1) The pilot must include a mutually agreed monitoring dashboard and a daily rolling error/latency feed to ArkByte (ops visibility).
2) Tickets and postmortems from Redwood must include prioritization of fixes and timeline commitments.
3) Commercial: approval for a one-time onboarding credit is fine up to 15%, Ben please confirm finance impact.

Ben — can you confirm we can support a one-time 15% contra on the first two invoices and that this doesn't exceed deal thresholds that need CFO approval? If yes, consider this an initial exec endorsement; Marissa can progress to final legal addendum.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
VP, Commercial Strategy
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA flexibility request for ArkByte pilot

Looping in final legal check — I've reviewed the proposed addendum and the redlines are minimal. We can approve the 99.5% pilot SLO and the 10% cap on service credits under these required guardrails: 

- Pilot-only clause with automatic reversion to standard SLO at renewal; we must attach an implementation timetable and monitoring KPIs.
- Limit on cumulative remediation liability: credits capped at 10% and sunset at pilot end.
- Require ArkByte to acknowledge monitoring access and a cooperative incident response process.
- Approve one-time onboarding commercial credit of 15% applied across first two invoices. Any additional commercial concession requires CFO signoff.

This is signed off from legal/commercial. Marissa — you have executive endorsement, please finalize the addendum and route to ArkByte for signature.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal Operations, Contracts & Deal Desk
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
